myproxy_user.description: The system user account under which MyProxy runs. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: myproxy).

myproxy_data_dir.description: The directory where MyProxy stores its database and credentials. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: /var/lib/myproxy).

x509_host_cert.description: Path to the host X.509 certificate for the MyProxy server. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: /etc/grid-security/myproxy/hostcert.pem).

x509_host_key.description: Path to the host X.509 private key for the MyProxy server. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: /etc/grid-security/myproxy/hostkey.pem).
